title: CompanyInfo no longer returns the NeoEnabled NameValue
summary: Since 2026-01-27 in production (2025-12-10 in sandbox), the CompanyInfo entity no longer includes the NeoEnabled attribute in its NameValue list. Code that looks up NeoEnabled gets no entry, while the API reference samples still show it.
migrationNote: Treat a missing NeoEnabled entry in CompanyInfo.NameValue as normal, and stop deciding behavior from it. The same applies to CompanyInfo returned by the query endpoint.
